welcome: NYS (Noble Youth Society), founded in 2017, is a non-profit organization dedicated to creating a global platform for all youth. Our team aims to establish a community that incorporates cooperation, collaboration, joint actions and collective endeavours to repay our society with care and generosity.

events.title: Seed Bussiness
paragraphs:
Seed is a non-profit organization that gladly given NYS a free booth were one of our member went there and participate within this event. This is where youth entrepreneur can bring their product and ideas to show or sell it towards real customers.
At the end our NYS member Jim have earn the most and granted the best seller title with his Nightflare plushy!

events.title: NYS Leadership meeting
paragraphs: NYS leaders have group up today in Ellen Sinclair Kennett Lodge on Friday Sept 26 during 1PM - 3PM, talking about many amazing event comming up and our yearly book/bottle drive and giving a invites to those who's interested in Bussiness a chance tosell their own product at West Vancouver Community Centre att Sunday 9AM - 1 PM under another non-profit organization. We're all happy to participate within the upcomming events see you there!

events.title: Garage sale
paragraphs:
On June 13th during 10AM - 2 PM we hosted a Garage sale where members sell their unwanted item or product to in our neighborhood.
All the members get to introduce their items to their neighbor and some people made a few sales witch will be donated.

events.title: Darts Hill Garden Park
paragraphs:
Our members and leader within NYS organization get to explore the Darts Hill Garden with a amazing guild showing us the different plants in our local area.
Taking a break from decice and walk around in nature, we also get to buy some plants at the end and the trip was amazing with no cost!

events.title: Plant learnging and selling
paragraphs:
On May 5th and 8th NYS members hosted a mothers day plant sale where members sell plants to members in our local area for monthers day event.
We also host a plant sale and learning lesson rasing hundreds of dollars for donation at the end of the year

events.title: Eco Friendly Carnival
paragraphs:
This is where NYS join up with other organization for a market sale base on eco friendly product on Apr 25. We sold many products like book, shirts and self made items.
Hundreds of guest have join the Carnival and we're happy that nearly everyone bring a smile back home after the day is complete.

events.title: NYS Annual Meeting
paragraphs: On Dec 3, 2025, NYS team has come together to celebrate the progress done on 2025 and had a small party togather. Looking at the past events and learning throught out the year.  It was celebrated near christmas and thank to everyone that volunteer towards the community.

events.title: NYS Bottle Drive
paragraphs: NYS hosted a bottle drive on Sunday, March 30, 2025, from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM to support the Peace Arch Hospital Foundation. Participants donated empty bottles and cans by leaving them at the curb by 10:00 AM or dropping them off at a Return-it Express site with pre-printed labels. Accepted items included aluminum cans, plastic bottles, liquor bottles, and beer cans or bottles. Donors used clear bags and limited glass bottles to 12 per bag.

events.title: NYS Annual Conference
paragraphs: On December 18, 2024, NYS celebrated its 2024 achievements with its Annual Conference, starting with a $2,000 donation to the Peace Arch Hospital Foundation for its production kitchen project. President Solenn Sun highlighted the year’s accomplishments, while the Foundation recognized volunteers with certificates. The event concluded with volunteers creating 100 Christmas cards for local seniors, showcasing NYS's dedication to community service and connection.

events.title: NYS Christmas Jazz Concert at Peace Arch Senior Village
paragraphs: On December 23, 2024, NYS hosted its annual Christmas Jazz Concert at Peace Portal Senior Village, bringing holiday cheer to senior residents. Featuring talented musicians performing holiday classics and jazz standards, the event created a lively, festive atmosphere where residents enjoyed live music and socialized. Organized by NYS volunteers, the concert was part of the organization’s efforts to support and connect with local communities during the holidays. The event highlighted the power of music to foster joy and connection, leaving attendees with smiles and warm holiday memories.

events.title: Charity Flea Market Supporting Peace Arch Hospital Foundation
paragraphs: On November 9, 2024, NYS and EcoNStyle hosted a Charity Flea Market at the South Surrey Community Centre, raising over $1,000 for the Peace Arch Foundation. With 20+ vendors, live music, and nearly 500 attendees, the event promoted sustainable living and community collaboration while supporting local businesses.

paragraphs: On August 17, Amy and James, two NYS members helped volunteer for the event

events.title: Peace Arch Hospital 70th Birthday Celebration
paragraphs: NYS volunteers joined the Peach Arch Hospital 70th Birthday Celebration on Aug 25th. They had a DIY tie-dye stand to help raise fund for the 10 million goal for Medical Imaging at Peace Arch Hospital!

events.title: DIY Tie-Dye Fundraiser
paragraphs: NYS Volunteers hosted a DIY Tie-Dye fundraiser to benefit Peace Arch Hospital Foundation at Crescent Beach on July 1 2024.

events.title: TEDx Grandview Heights Volunteers
paragraphs: On June 28 2024, NYS Volunteers worked at TEDx-Grandview Heights at Surrey Arts Centre.

events.title: Volunteering for a urban planning workshop
paragraphs: NYS provided volunteer service to an urban planning workshop on May 26, 2024 at Semiahmoo Library. Our volunteers are busy preparing hand-made candles, home-grown vegetable and bakery for our Green Home Gift Pack Sale at the event!

events.title: Richmond Hospital Donut Fundraiser
paragraphs: In April 2022, NYS organized a donut fundraiser for Richmond Hospital Foundation.
12 volunteers, 180 donuts sold within the two days, 200 dollars profits for donation, and numerous commendations...

events.title: Christmas Cards For Seniors 2021
paragraphs: On the Christmas Eve of 2021, we delivered 110 Christmas cards to senior activity centres and retirement homes across Vancouver. Click the button for more information on the event.

events.title: West Vancouver Branch Established
paragraphs: In 2019, we started another Noble Youth Society branch in West Vancouver. Check out moments from our opening ceremony!

events.title: Foodie Club Season II
paragraphs: In 2018, we held our second Foodie Club event, "Golden spoon". Click to see the photo gallery for this event.

events.title: Foodie Club
paragraphs: In 2017, we held our first Foodie club event "little chef". Check out for more!

members.name: Solenn Sun
paragraphs: I’m Solenn Sun, a grade 12 student from Semiahmoo Secondary School in Surrey. I have been a member of the NYS Club since 2022 and currently hold the honor of being its president. I am committed to utilizing my talents and leadership skills to organize more activities, offering volunteering opportunities for teenagers to contribute to their communities. Everywhere I go, I always carry with me a quote: "It's nice to be important, but it's more important to be nice." My goal is to embody this sentiment in the NYS club, exploring the uniqueness and generosity among every club member.

members.name: Amy Deng
paragraphs: I'm Amy Deng, currently a grade 11 student. I have a passion for drawing and playing piano, and I also serve as one of the directors of NYS. I aim to leverage my energy and skills to enhance NYS as an organization. My motto is to "Embrace challenges, pursue excellence."

members.name: James Yin
paragraphs: Hi, my name is James. I currently attend grade 11, and I have been a member of NYS since 2022. As the Vice President, I hope to bring out everybody's diverse talents and utilize them for the betterment of our collective community. Some of my interests include business, finance, and music. I look forward to working with you all!

members.name: Micah Hou
paragraphs: I am Micah Hou, a grade 10 member of NYS. Serving as the President of EPS's 3D Printing Club and as one of the designers in revamping EPS's website, I aim to provide technical support to NYS in our events as well as maintaining and improving NYS's website and other technical infrastructure. This year as IT Director my goal is to migrate our website onto cloud hosting services under our own domain. It's going to be a exciting year, stay tuned!

members.name: Jimin Pei
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Jimin Pei, a Grade 10 student at Elgin Park Secondary. I enjoy playing tennis, musical instruments, and collecting various items. I’ve been part of NYS for over two years and currently serve as Treasurer. I hope to use my time and skills to support NYS and help make it an even better organization behind the scenes. Looking forward to seeing you all this year!

members.name: Yuki Shi
paragraphs: I'm Yuki Shi, a grade 9 student from GHS.I have been a member of NYS since 2023. I enjoy dancing and playing the piano. I will utilize my abilities and tap into my potential, hoping to grow together with NYS and form a bigger family.

members.name: Hanqing Jin
paragraphs: I’m Hanqing, and I am currently a grade 10 student at Grandview Heights Secondary. I have been a member of NYS since 2021, and I’m passionate about creativity and sharing the work we do here. I enjoy dancing and playing the piano, and I’m always open to learning and trying new ideas. My goal is to help make our events stand out through clear and engaging content now that I have been selected for the Media Officer role. I am excited to build onto my goals and support my members throughout this new journey.

members.name: Sophie Liu
paragraphs: Hi, my name is Sophie Liu and I am a grade 11 IB student at Semiahmoo Secondary. I am honoured to take on the role of VP for public relations for NYS this year. As someone who loves turning ideas into action, I am extremely excited to coordinate projects that can make genuine impact across our community. Outside of school, I enjoy Latin dancing and reading, as well as spending time with my sister.

members.name: Mark Hou
paragraphs:
Motivated and community-oriented Grade 11 student seeking the Marketing Executive position
at NYS. Having participated in numerous Eco Fabrica events, I have seen firsthand the
positive impact the organization has on our community. My goal is to help expand NYS's
reach by promoting its initiatives, attracting more volunteers, and increasing community

members.name: Jeffery Kong
paragraphs: My name is Jeffrey Kong. I’m currently grade 12 at Earl Marriott Secondary and I’ve been a member since 2026. I enjoy art, playing instruments, and skiing. In addition, I serve as the Technical officer of NYS.  I aim to provide technical assistance and maintenance for NYS. Thank you.

members.name: Andy Shen
paragraphs: My name is Andy Shen I am a grade 10 student in Semiamoo Secondary.I hope to use my skill to help NYS to become greater.

members.name: Zoe Shao
paragraphs: Im Zoe shao, currently i am a grade 9 student at GHS. I have a passion for volleyball, skiing and all kinds of sports. Also animals like dogs and cats. I serve for  logistics officer assistant for NYS. I have been a member of NYS since 2025. I aim to volunteer more, become closer with NYS and enhance my skills in helping with things that i can help with.
